unit_label: BRBL C U04: Relate scheme, qualified buyer, security receipt and sponsor to their distinct roles

facts.statement: Scheme invites subscription to receipts; security receipt evidences undivided interest in financial asset under scheme issued to qualified buyer. Qualified buyer is statutory/notified category, not any investor. Sponsor has at least10% paid-up equity holding.

payload.title: Investor evidence is not the same as full ownership of each collateral item
payload.core_explanation_md:
A scheme invites subscription to security receipts. The receipt evidences the described undivided right, title or interest in the financial asset involved in securitisation. It should not be described as automatic personal ownership of every underlying collateral item, a bank deposit, or a guarantee that the claim will be collected.

Qualified buyer is a defined category, read with applicable notifications rather than an assumption that every retail investor qualifies. Sponsor is a different role, based on holding not less than ten per cent of the ARC paid-up equity. A person holding a security receipt is not automatically a sponsor: an interest in the financial asset and an equity holding in the company are different interests.

self_check.prompt_text: Does holding a security receipt automatically establish sponsor status?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Sponsor status uses the specified paid-up equity holding, not mere receipt ownership.

payload.stem_md: An investor owns a security receipt but no stipulated ARC equity. The register labels the investor sponsor solely because of the receipt. Which distinction is needed?

options.text_md: Every receipt holder must hold all ARC equity
options.explanation_md: Receipt ownership does not establish a company equity holding.

options.text_md: The receipt interest and the sponsor equity-holding test are separate
options.explanation_md: Sponsor status depends on the specified paid-up equity threshold.

options.text_md: A receipt is automatically a demand deposit with the ARC
options.explanation_md: The receipt evidences the defined financial-asset interest.

options.text_md: Every debtor is a qualified buyer by default
options.explanation_md: Qualified-buyer status requires the relevant defined/notified category.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Sponsor status depends on the specified paid-up equity threshold.

payload.stem_md: A sales note promises that a security receipt gives its holder exclusive ownership of each underlying building and guarantees recovery. Which correction follows the definition?

options.text_md: The promise is correct whenever the receipt has a serial number
options.explanation_md: A serial number does not change the legal interest or guarantee recovery.

options.text_md: The receipt cancels all remaining borrower obligations
options.explanation_md: A receipt issue does not establish discharge of the financial asset.

options.text_md: The receipt automatically becomes a bank fixed deposit
options.explanation_md: The defined instrument is not a bank-deposit promise.

options.text_md: The receipt evidences the stated undivided financial-asset interest; recovery and individual-property title are different matters
options.explanation_md: The instrument should be described according to its legal interest, without unsupported guarantees.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The instrument should be described according to its legal interest, without unsupported guarantees.
